question: Should the package preserve the existing native `openBeneath()` numeric return contract and expose containment through a new additive API, or intentionally ship a documented breaking API change?
rationale: The branch introduces a public native API incompatibility while adding useful metadata; selecting the permanent API shape requires maintainer ownership of the package contract.

options.title: Use an additive containment API
options.body: Preserve `openBeneath()` as a numeric-fd API and expose containment through a new companion call or opt-in result API with compatibility tests.

options.title: Ship a breaking native API change
options.body: Keep the object return only if maintainers explicitly accept the upgrade break and provide an appropriate versioning and migration path.

recommendation.title: Use an additive containment API
recommendation.body: Preserve `openBeneath()` as a numeric-fd API and expose containment through a new companion call or opt-in result API with compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history is limited, but this contributor authored the active containment and native API design changes.
